cvEn:
Moshe Agam Rotbah, son of Golda and Leon, was born in Romania on 14 Nisan 5706 (15 April 1946) and immigrated to Israel in 1948. Moshe attended elementary school in Haifa and graduated from the "Bsmat" vocational school as a refrigeration technician. In the IDF he was trained as a gunner and combat engineer. He later served as a refrigeration technician, and was responsible and dedicated to his role. His commander testified about him that he was an excellent soldier, carried out his duties with distinction, and, while acting as an officer, filled the role in the best possible way.

Moshe received the Six-Day War medal and the Yom Kippur War medal. He fell on 28 Elul 5744 (25 September 1984) while serving in the reserves, and was laid to rest in the military cemetery at Havat HaCarmel. He was 38 years old at the time of his death. He left a wife and two daughters.
